attempts.summary: Used Ansible from control node2 (ansible.posix.sysctl module) to persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1. Set net.ipv4.conf.{all,default}.accept_redirects=0 and net.ipv4.conf.{all,default}.accept_source_route=0, persisted to /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf and applied at runtime. Both node1 and node2 were then restarted one at a time via the native reboot mechanism; boot-id changes confirmed genuine restarts, and post-restart verification confirmed the hardening settings survived on node1 and Ansible control functionality recovered on node2.
